notes.title: 1.0.0d Patch Notes
notes.notes:
General Fixes


 Resolved an error that occurred when attempting to change game speed during loading.
 Fixed various issues related to car transport jobs.

notes.title: 1.0.0c Patch Notes
notes.notes:
General Fixes


 Resolved an issue with UI scaling.
 Fixed excessive memory usage after extended play sessions.

Assembly Job Adjustments


 Transporting Part Energy Modifier: Reduced from 1.0 to 0.8.
 Mounting Part Energy Modifier: Increased from 0.1 to 0.25.

Conveyor System Fixes


 Addressed several job-related errors occurring after some conveyor changes.

notes.title: Update & Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41362798/8294fbdce47ef423ca54a9ea0eeab8d34a333bbf.png

Dear Manufacturers,

Car Manufacture will launch in Early Access on August 1st, 2024, at 6:00 PM CEST.

As we are all awaiting the release, let's take a look into some changes to the Prologue. With this announcement's publication, you will receive a new updated version of Car Manufacture: Prologue. 

What's new?

 Improved Tutorial
 "War Order" challenge
 Languages support
 More accessibility settings
 Fixes and overall improvements

Due to changes and work done on the project, previous saves will be unavailable. We are sorry for the inconvenience.

We hope you will enjoy it.

Cheers,
Stereo Games Development Team

Don't forget to add Car Manufacture to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/983380/Car_Manufacture/

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41362798/eb7be50b0bcf93519c2a78e4fd04247d2fcae3f4.png

Dear Manufacturers,

We are happy to announce that Car Manufacture: Prologue will be officially released on Steam on Friday, September 1st, 2023 @ 5 PM CEST.

Thanks to all of you who took part in the recent Playtest.

Don't forget to wishlist and follow the game on Steam for more upcoming news.

Hope you like it! Tell us what you think.
Join us in the comments and our official Discord server.
